entries.title: Fortress
items: Atlas passive points that buff all maps with essences, wisps, strongboxes, shrines, rogue exiles, +2 mods on tablets, and more.
Tip: Explore for Matriarch and Patriarch halls later (red beams in the fog) to mass complete the fortress.
Tip: +waystone chance makes you drop two fragments.

entries.title: Precursor Towers
items: Tip: To explore 70% more area with each tower, grab the Atlas passive that increases tower exploration radius by 30%.

entries.title: Abyss
items: Abyss crafting currency such as Preserved Rib.
Kulemak Invitations to farm Ancient Bones. Each Kulemak kill guarantees one.
Undying Hate unique jewel from Kulemak.

entries.title: Breach
items: Amulets, rings and belts with minion mods.
Amulets, rings and belts with caster mods.
Catalysts for ring and amulet quality.
Absent Amulet — unique amulet bases that reserve a random spirit skill while costing no spirit.
Altered Collarbone — adds otherworldly breach mods to an item without needing to craft it from the Genesis Tree.

entries.title: Temple
items: Ancient Soul Cores from the core destabilizer room.

entries.title: Delirium
items: Effect of Prefix or Suffix crafted modifiers on a jewel.
Very Large Radius crafted modifier on a Time-lost jewel.
Raven-Touched Shard to instill a notable to your helm slot.
Megalomaniac and Voices unique jewels from Simulacrum.

entries.title: Expedition
items: Blazing Fluxes for resistance swapping on gear.
Masterwork Runes for upgrading Greater Runes to Perfect Runes.
+1 permanent passive or +10 permanent Spirit unlock — very rare.

entries.title: Trial of the Sekhemas
items: Tip: One jewel of each color can be combined into a Diamond, including Time-lost Diamonds. This consumes Exalts.

entries.title: Rogue Exiles
items: Tons of rings, amulets and belts.
Heart of the Well from Abyss-influenced rogue exile drops.

entries.title: Shrines
items: ilvl 82 rare loot explosions from the 'bosses get buffed by shrine instead' Atlas node.
Enlightened shrine — jewel explosion, no equipment.
Other shrine types can produce corresponding tag-based loot explosions.

entries.title: Boss Rush Maps
items: Use only Irradiated Tablets, Overseer Tablets, or empty tablet slots.
Each non-league-mechanic tablet slot increases tablet drop chance from random content appearing in the map.
Filling all three slots with the same league mechanic causes only that mechanic to appear and results in fewer tablets of that type.

entries.title: Unique Maps
items: Mirror Lake — -1 prefix / +1 suffix amulet and ring bases.
Anomaly maps — rare Lineage support gems.

entries.title: Cleansed Maps
items: Tip: Summoning Circles also help obtain Fracturing Orbs. Use tablets with extra Summoning Circles.

entries.title: Jado's Spycraft
items: More exceptional items and unique strongboxes.
Buffing multiple tablets of the same kind.

entries.title: Doryani's Science
items: Chance to find citadels and teleport to them.
Terraforming maps to a specific biome.

entries.title: Hilda's Hunting
items: More tablet effects for each different tablet.

entries.title: Gold
items: +3 amulets by gambling amulets at the Ange NPC.

entries.title: Attack Skills
items: Make sure your weapon is as good as it can be.

entries.title: Early Crafting
items: Feel free to spend crafting currencies to become powerful early on.

entries.title: Check Vendors
items: Check vendors each level-up for good items.

entries.title: Resistances
items: Try to achieve resistance values similar to your level.
Example: at level 30, aim for roughly 30% all resistance.
Act 2 — prioritize Lightning resistance for the final boss fights.

entries.title: Ascendancy
items: If you don't immediately need your Ascendancy, you can skip it for a few levels and return when stronger.

entries.title: Permanent Campaign Power
items: Try to collect all campaign permanent power boosts.

entries.title: After the First Precursor Tower
items: Start the Fortress questline to unlock Atlas passive nodes affecting all maps.

entries.title: First Fortress Priorities
items: Path toward the Atlas node that unlocks +1 tablet mod.
There is one in the center of the tree and one at the very top; rush the first one.
Use CTRL+F to search for early Tablet and Waystone nodes.
Unlock 'Irradiated tablets can now drop' — they do not drop by default anymore.
Clear a corrupted tower area to unlock Doryani as a master.
Doryani gives +1 revive, allowing 6-mod maps with 3 tablets and double the tries.

entries.title: Stay in the Fortress
items: Stay in the Fortress until you have T15 maps and roughly 50–100 Atlas points.

entries.title: Choose Your Endgame Path
items: If you want a specific league mechanic, venture out and do its questline with semi-decent Atlas bonuses until you unlock most of its tree.
If your build is strong, finish the Arbiter of Divinity questline in the Fortress for roughly +40 Atlas points.
Then rush to the top of the Atlas tree for 4-mod tablets.

entries.title: Later Atlas Progression
items: Hunt Matriarch / Patriarch citadels, shown by red beams in the fog.
These allow you to do Arbiter of Divinity additional times for roughly +40 Atlas points per kill.
Alternatively, finish the Atlas manually one map at a time.

entries.title: Atlas Progression Warning
items: Normal mapping does NOT progress Atlas.
Only maps within the Fortress walls progress Atlas.
